description: WordPress sites: apply the one-click fix a run proposes (get_run proposedFix: e.g. clear a stuck maintenance file, turn indexing back on, roll back the plugin update that broke it) through the Relvato plugin, then re-run the monitor to confirm. Only that exact fix can be applied. Tell the user what it changes (proposedFix.why and undo) and get their go-ahead first. undo: true reverts the last fix Relvato applied on the site.

runId.description: The run that proposes the fix

undo.description: Revert the last fix applied on this site instead

name: apply_fix
title: Apply a run's proposed fix
